Store

Templates and snippets for every kind of paper.

LatexDo already includes the citation manager, table builder, TikZ converter, notation manager and submission checks. The store adds what it does not ship: venue templates, a thesis, a CV, a poster, and snippet packs for plots, tables, algorithms, math, chemistry, code and revisions. Everything is free.
